source: docs/factory_logistics_network_design.md (draft numbers adopted as final for the 2026-11-16 overnight build, DECISIONS.md #1)
astrologyNote: Granted at the side day start through the pinned native astrology add (GameSymbols.FactoryLogisticsArcane): astrologyPerTown per owned town in an Arcane Manufactory's range, at most its effective level of towns per Manufactory; Arcane level texts quote these numbers (DECISIONS.md #55, supersedes #36).

enhancements.name: Byproduct Processing
levelLines: +100 gold per day.
+200 gold per day; the mine produces 50% more.
+350 gold per day; the mine produces twice its normal amount.

enhancements.name: Export Office
levelLines: Replaces the mine's output: gold = 2x your market sell value of that output.
Gold = 3x your market sell value of the mine's output.
Gold = 4x your market sell value of the mine's output.

enhancements.name: Warehouse
levelLines: Replaces the mine's output; your other logistics enhancements cost 20% less.
Other logistics enhancements cost 40% less.
Other logistics enhancements cost 60% less.

enhancements.name: Rail Station
levelLines: Replaces the mine's output; +0.5 day of range for your whole network; also a full Logistics Hub.
+1.0 day of network range; full Logistics Hub.
+1.5 days of network range; full Logistics Hub.

enhancements.name: Power Station
levelLines: Replaces the mine's output; enhanced buildings in range get +1 powered level.
Enhanced buildings in range get +2 powered levels.
Enhanced buildings in range get +3 powered levels.

enhancements.name: Material Synthesizer
levelLines: Replaces the mine's output; Export Offices and Mercenary Headquarters in range pay x1.33; +1 market for 1 town in range.
x1.66; +1 market for up to 2 towns in range.
x2 (x3 when fully powered); +1 market for up to 3 towns in range.

enhancements.name: Arcane Manufactory
levelLines: Replaces the mine's output; heroes in range +1 to all stats; +250 astrology a day for 1 town in range; 1/6 of dwelling growth upgraded.
+2 to all stats of heroes in range; +250 astrology a day per town, up to 2 towns; 2/6 of dwelling growth upgraded.
+3 to all stats of heroes in range; +250 astrology a day per town, up to 3 towns; 3/6 of dwelling growth upgraded.

enhancements.name: Logistics Hub
levelLines: Adds to output (the building works as normal); routes passing through regain 33% of the range they spent.
Routes passing through regain 66% of spent range.
Routes passing through regain all spent range.

enhancements.name: Food Distribution Center
levelLines: +33% weekly units.
+66% weekly units.
+100% weekly units; the extra units appear for hire as soon as this level is built.

enhancements.name: Housing Office
levelLines: Units hired here cost 20% less.
Units hired here cost 40% less.
Units hired here cost 60% less.

enhancements.name: Rail Network
levelLines: Hire remotely; units go to a town in range.
Hire remotely to a town; this dwelling's routes get +0.5 day of range.
Hire remotely to a town or hero; this dwelling's routes get +1.0 day of range.

enhancements.name: Mercenary Headquarters
levelLines: Replaces the dwelling's units: each week, gold equal to their purchase price.
Gold = 2x the purchase price of the units it would have produced.
Gold = 3x the purchase price of the units it would have produced.

enhancements.name: Support Hub
levelLines: Replaces the dwelling's units; other external dwellings in range produce 15% more units each week.
Other external dwellings in range produce 30% more units.
Other external dwellings in range produce 45% more units.
